notation: Shared anatomy owned by more than one component. Component-specific parts are nodes in their component manifest. Owning a part does not make it a consumer insertion slot unless the summary says so. The five slot parts form the construction pattern [leading] [prefix] [contents] [suffix] [trailing]; their selectors are relative to the slotted host: the component itself, the input control, the select trigger, the collapsible trigger or a tab.

slot-leading.summary: Leading slot (6u). Authored children with slot="leading" move here; usually one <i name> icon. Hidden when empty.

slot-prefix.summary: Prefix: a short text adornment before the label (currency, unit, scope). Authored children with slot="prefix" move here; label color at 65%. Hidden when empty.

slot-contents.summary: Contents slot: every authored child without a slot attribute (the label text). Hidden when empty, so an icon-only control is square.

slot-suffix.summary: Suffix: a short text adornment after the label (unit, shortcut, count). Authored children with slot="suffix" move here; label color at 65%. Hidden when empty.

slot-trailing.summary: Trailing slot (6u). Authored children with slot="trailing" move here. Hidden when empty.

field-label.summary: Visible label span from the label property, wired to the control with aria-labelledby; clicking it focuses the control. Hidden without a label.

field-description.summary: Help text from the description property, wired with aria-describedby. Hidden when empty.

field-error.summary: The error message: the author error property at once, or the validation message after interaction. Wired with aria-describedby and aria-invalid.

track.summary: The 1u track of a range or progress bar.

track-indicator.summary: The filled portion of the track (Base UI Slider.Indicator / Progress.Indicator), sized by --ui-ratio.

dialog-trigger.summary: The element that opens a dialog, alert dialog or drawer (usually a ui-button; aria-haspopup=dialog, aria-expanded, aria-controls; data-popup-open while open). Authored; outside the popup. Base UI Dialog.Trigger.

dialog-backdrop.summary: The bg.backdrop overlay under the popup in the top layer (data-open / data-closed; hidden for a nested layer). Generated unless authored. Base UI Dialog.Backdrop.

dialog-popup.summary: The window (role=dialog or alertdialog, aria-modal while modal, tabindex=-1), in the top layer while open (data-open / data-closed, data-nested, data-nested-dialog-open, --nested-dialogs). Generated from the children unless authored. Base UI Dialog.Popup.

dialog-title.summary: The heading that names the popup (aria-labelledby): an h2 from the label property, or authored. Base UI Dialog.Title.

dialog-description.summary: The paragraph that describes the popup (aria-describedby): a p from the description property, or authored. Base UI Dialog.Description.

dialog-actions.summary: The row of actions at the popup's end (ours): its buttons 2u apart, at the end edge, wrapping. Authored.

dialog-close.summary: An element inside the popup that closes it with reason close-press (usually a ui-button). Authored. Base UI Dialog.Close.
